title: अध्यात्म र मानव जीवन {Spirituality and Human Life}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख अध्यात्म र मानव जीवनसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको छ । यस लेख अन्तर्गत अध्यात्म के हो ? पूर्वीय दर्शनले दुःख, धर्म, कर्म, पाप, प्रारब्ध, लोभ, मोह क्रोधबाट जीवनलाई कसरी मुक्ति प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ भन्ने कुराको समीक्षण गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनको उद्देश्यका रूपमा अध्यात्म र मानव जीवनको सम्बन्ध पहिल्याउनु, अध्यात्म र भौतिकवादले सृष्टि, जन्म, मृत्यु, सुख, दुःख र प्रारब्धबारे विवेचना गर्नु रहेको छ । जीवनलाई कसरी सुख, शान्त, आनन्दमय बनाउन सकिन्छ, सांसारिक मायाजालबाट कसरी मुक्ति मिल्दछ । सम्पूर्ण पाश्चात्य र पूर्वीय दर्शनले मानवजीवनलाई हेर्ने दृष्टिकोण केलाउनु रहेको छ । आजको मानव जीवन, हाम्रा चार ओटै धर्म, पूर्वी र पश्चिमी दुवै दर्शनको एउटै लक्ष्य सुखको खोजी गर्नु रहेको छ । आज अध्यात्म र विज्ञानको समन्वय गरी यस संसारलाई समृद्ध बनाउन सकिने कुरामा जोड दिइएको पाइन्छ । {The presented article is related to spirituality and human life. What is spirituality under this article? Eastern philosophy has reviewed how life can be freed from suffering, religion, karma, sin, desire, greed, and anger. The purpose of the present study is to find the relationship between spirituality and human life, to discuss about creation, birth, death, happiness, sorrow and predestination by spirituality and materialism. How can life be made happy, peaceful, joyful, how can one be freed from worldly illusions. All western and eastern philosophies have different views on human life. Human life today, our four religions, both Eastern and Western philosophies have the same goal of seeking happiness. Today, it is emphasized that this world can be enriched by coordinating spirituality and science.}
american_english: The present article is related to spirituality and human life. What is spirituality in this article? It reviews how Eastern philosophy can help life attain liberation from suffering, religion, karma, sin, prarabdha (destiny), greed, attachment and anger. The objectives of the present study are to identify the relationship between spirituality and human life, and to discuss creation, birth, death, happiness, suffering and prarabdha in relation to spirituality and materialism. How can life be made happy, peaceful and joyful, and how can one attain liberation from the worldly web of illusion (maya)? It examines the viewpoints with which all Western and Eastern philosophies regard human life. Today's human life, our four religions, and both Eastern and Western philosophies share a single goal: the search for happiness. Today, emphasis is being placed on the view that this world can be enriched by coordinating spirituality and science.
british_english: The present article is concerned with spirituality and human life. What is spirituality in this article? It reviews how Eastern philosophy can help life attain liberation from suffering, religion, karma, sin, prarabdha (fate), greed, attachment and anger. The objectives of the present study are to ascertain the relationship between spirituality and human life, and to discuss creation, birth, death, happiness, suffering and prarabdha in relation to spirituality and materialism. How can life be made happy, peaceful and joyful, and how can one attain liberation from the worldly web of illusion (maya)? It also examines the standpoints from which all Western and Eastern philosophies regard human life. Today's human life, our four religions, and both Eastern and Western philosophies share one and the same goal: the search for happiness. Today, emphasis is placed on the view that this world can be enriched by co-ordinating spirituality and science.
australian_english: This article is about spirituality and human life. What is spirituality in this article? It takes a look at how Eastern philosophy can help life win liberation from suffering, religion, karma, sin, prarabdha (fate), greed, attachment and anger. The aims of the study are to work out the relationship between spirituality and human life, and to discuss creation, birth, death, happiness, suffering and prarabdha from the angles of spirituality and materialism. How can life be made happy, peaceful and joyful, and how can one break free from the worldly web of illusion (maya)? It also goes through the viewpoints from which all Western and Eastern philosophies look at human life. Today's human life, our four religions, and both Eastern and Western philosophies share a single goal: the search for happiness. Today, emphasis is falling on the idea that this world can be enriched by bringing spirituality and science together.
informal_english: So this article's about spirituality and human life. It takes a look at what spirituality actually is, and how Eastern philosophy reckons you can free yourself from suffering, dharma, karma, sin, prarabdha (fate), greed, attachment and anger. The aims of the study are to work out the relationship between spirituality and human life, and to have a proper look at creation, birth, death, happiness, suffering and prarabdha from the spiritual and materialist angles. How do you make life happy, calm and joyful, and how do you break free from the old worldly web of maya? It also goes through how the Western and Eastern philosophies see human life. Today's human life, our four religions, and both Eastern and Western philosophy all share one goal: chasing happiness. And these days, there's a real push on bringing spirituality and science together to enrich the world.

Sanskrit/Nepali terms (prarabdha, karma, dharma, maya) transliterated with English glosses on first occurrence. Sentence order preserved; interrogative punctuation added where the Nepali is plainly questioning.
